knowledge:
- key_parameters: tracrRNA=Specifies the type of tracrRNA used in getRuleSet3Scores, either "Hsu2013" or "Chen2013" ;; condaEnv=The file path to the specific conda environment built for Python-based algorithms (RuleSet3, DeepHF, enPAM+GB, Lindel) ;; enzyme=Specifies the Cas9 variant in getDeepHFScores, options are "WT" (default), "HF", or "ESP" ;; promoter=Specifies the promoter used for expressing sgRNAs in getDeepHFScores (default is "U6") ;; directRepeat=Specifies the direct repeat sequence used in the CasRx construct in getCasRxRFScores (defaults to "aacccctaccaactggtcggggtttgaaac") ;; binaries=Path to external binaries for RNAfold, RNAplfold, and RNAhybrid in getCasRxRFScores; if NULL, they must be on the system PATH ;; spacers=Character vector of 20bp spacer sequences for getMITScores and getCFDScores ;; protospacers=Character vector of 20bp protospacer sequences of putative off-targets for getMITScores and getCFDScores ;; pams=Character vector of PAM sequences for getMITScores and getCFDScores
- alternatives: RuleSet3 and DeepHF are recommended as more modern and performant alternatives to the deprecated Azimuth algorithm ;; enPAM+GB is recommended as an alternative to the deprecated DeepCpf1 algorithm ;; crisprDesign is a higher-level package that automates sequence extraction and calls crisprScore internally via addOnTargetScores
- when_to_use: Use when designing CRISPR gRNAs to evaluate and select candidates with high on-target cutting efficiency, low off-target activity, or high probability of causing frameshift mutations
- pitfalls: Python 2-based algorithms (Azimuth, DeepCpf1, DeepSpCas9, CRISPRai) are no longer supported ;; DeepHF and enPAM+GB are not supported on Windows machines ;; Users must manually build and manage conda environments for Python-based algorithms (RuleSet3, DeepHF, enPAM+GB, Lindel) and pass the environment path to condaEnv ;; CasRxRF requires external command-line tools (RNAfold, RNAplfold, RNAhybrid) to be installed and accessible ;; Different scoring algorithms require highly specific sequence lengths and contexts (e.g., 30bp for RuleSet1/3, 23bp for DeepHF, 35bp for CRISPRscan, 20bp for CRISPRater, 34bp for enPAM+GB, 65bp for Lindel) relative to the PAM site

workflows.name: on_target_efficiency_prediction
workflows.intent: Predict on-target cutting efficiency for Cas9, Cas12a, or Cas13d gRNAs using sequence-based algorithms.
input: sequences.txt (character vector of target sequences with specific flanking contexts)
test.fa (FASTA file containing mRNA sequence for CasRxRF)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the package and prepare input sequences with correct flanking lengths ;; 2. Run RuleSet1 scoring using getRuleSet1Scores ;; 3. Run RuleSet3 scoring using getRuleSet3Scores with a specified conda environment ;; 4. Run DeepHF scoring using getDeepHFScores with a specified conda environment ;; 5. Run CRISPRscan scoring using getCRISPRscanScores ;; 6. Run CRISPRater scoring using getCRISPRaterScores ;; 7. Run enPAM+GB scoring for Cas12a using getEnPAMGBScores ;; 8. Run CasRxRF scoring for Cas13d using getCasRxRFScores on a DNAStringSet
workflows.code:
flank5 <- "ACCT" #4bp
spacer <- "ATCGATGCTGATGCTAGATA" #20bp
pam    <- "AGG" #3bp 
flank3 <- "TTG" #3bp
input  <- paste0(flank5, spacer, pam, flank3) 
results <- getRuleSet1Scores(input)

condaEnv <- "/Users/fortin946/miniforge3/envs/rs3-env"
results <- getRuleSet3Scores(input, tracrRNA="Hsu2013", condaEnv=condaEnv)

spacer  <- "ATCGATGCTGATGCTAGATA" #20bp
pam     <- "AGG" #3bp
input   <- paste0(spacer, pam)
condaEnv <- "/Users/fortin946/miniforge3/envs/deephf-env"
results <- getDeepHFScores(input, condaEnv=condaEnv)

flank5 <- "ACCTAA" #6bp
spacer <- "ATCGATGCTGATGCTAGATA" #20bp
pam    <- "AGG" #3bp 
flank3 <- "TTGAAT" #6bp
input  <- paste0(flank5, spacer, pam, flank3) 
results <- getCRISPRscanScores(input)

spacer <- "ATCGATGCTGATGCTAGATA" #20bp
results <- getCRISPRaterScores(spacer)

flank5 <- "ACCG" #4bp
pam    <- "TTTT" #4bp
spacer <- "AATCGATGCTGATGCTAGATATT" #23bp
flank3 <- "AAG" #3bp
input  <- paste0(flank5, pam, spacer, flank3)
condaEnv <- "/Users/fortin946/miniforge3/envs/enpamgb-env"
results <- getEnPAMGBScores(input, condaEnv=condaEnv)

fasta <- file.path(system.file(package="crisprScore"),
                   "casrxrf/test.fa")
mrnaSequence <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(filepath=fasta,
                                             format="fasta",
                                             use.names=TRUE)
results <- getCasRxRFScores(mrnaSequence)

workflows.name: off_target_specificity_prediction
workflows.intent: Predict off-target specificity of gRNAs against potential genomic off-target sites using MIT and CFD scoring.
input: protospacers.txt (character vector of 20bp protospacer sequences of putative off-targets)
workflows.stages: 1. Define spacer, protospacer, and PAM sequences ;; 2. Calculate MIT scores using getMITScores ;; 3. Calculate CFD scores using getCFDScores
workflows.code:
spacer   <- "ATCGATGCTGATGCTAGATA"
protospacers  <- c("ACCGATGCTGATGCTAGATA",
                   "ATCGATGCTGATGCTAGATT",
                   "ATCGATGCTGATGCTAGATA")
pams <- c("AGG", "AGG", "AGA")
getMITScores(spacers=spacer,
             protospacers=protospacers,
             pams=pams)

getCFDScores(spacers=spacer,
             protospacers=protospacers,
             pams=pams)

workflows.name: indel_frameshift_prediction
workflows.intent: Predict the probability of a Cas9 gRNA to produce indels inducing a frameshift mutation using the Lindel algorithm.
input: sequences.txt (character vector of 65bp sequences containing 13bp upstream, 23bp protospacer, and 29bp downstream flanking regions)
workflows.stages: 1. Define the 65bp sequence context around the protospacer ;; 2. Run Lindel scoring using getLindelScores with a specified conda environment
workflows.code:
flank5 <- "ACCTTTTAATCGA" #13bp
spacer <- "TGCTGATGCTAGATATTAAG" #20bp
pam    <- "TGG" #3bp
flank3 <- "CTTTTAATCGATGCTGATGCTAGATATTA" #29bp
input <- paste0(flank5, spacer, pam, flank3)
condaEnv <- "/Users/fortin946/miniforge3/envs/lindel-env"
results <- getLindelScores(input, condaEnv=condaEnv)
